mentions.name: Demon Cleaners
mentions.description: This browser-based top-down shooter (with co-op planned) is built with Phaser, standard web tech, and WebAssembly compiled from a Go engine running on the server, aiming to make browser games feel more like Steam games.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on top down shooter for the browser (co-op to come) https://www.demoncleaners.com/

This uses phaser, standard web tech, wasm (built from Go engine running on server).
